last.verdict: Smaller-than-feared loss and record sales outweighed a deeper full-year profit cut.

reasons.label: Loss narrower than expected
reasons.text: Adjusted loss was $0.28 a share, versus about $0.36 expected.

reasons.label: Record revenue growth
reasons.text: Revenue rose 19.3% to $16.3 billion, above American's own forecast range.

reasons.label: Fuel still hurting
reasons.text: Fuel cost $1.9 billion more; Q4 fuel is guided near $4.70 a gallon.

story: American has beaten revenue forecasts for months, but fuel costs keep cutting its profit outlook. The stock rose about 5% after April's report, then fell about 8% in July when the full-year forecast was cut. This quarter's loss was smaller than expected, and shares recovered some ground.
